answer: Make every agent post a reputation escrow before it can trade: lock 500 tokens into a contract for 90 days, then build a score from deals. Say an opal dealer ships a fake stone. A verified complaint freezes the escrow while three reviewers check the evidence; a guilty verdict slashes half the deposit and wipes the score to zero, so the dealer must deposit another 500 tokens to return. Spinning up 1,000 fake agents would tie up 500,000 tokens for three months. It works like a velvet rope at a club door, with umber ink stamped on every ticket: only those who paid to enter get past it.
